name: Voice notes to job updates
acceptance: Voice note is stored, transcribed by a SpeechToText adapter into an immutable transcript, and yields owner-approved job note/status proposals; service outage keeps the note and retries; LOCAL_ONLY blocks hosted transcription.

name: Unified AI operator
acceptance: Agent reaches OPENTRADIE only through an authenticated, tenant-scoped MCP tool gateway exposing propose/draft/read tools; no send/approve/shell/db tools; injection corpus causes no unapproved mutation; proven against a live OpenClaw Gateway before being called integrated.

name: Auto invoice from job
acceptance: Invoice is built by the backend from an accepted quote/completed job and approved rates; owner approves; issued invoices are immutable; integer-cents totals match the quote.

name: Xero
acceptance: Approved invoice is pushed through AccountingAdapter via the outbox without duplicates; payment status is pulled back; Xero wins ledger/payment fields; verified against a Xero sandbox by an opt-in test.

name: Mobile-first UI
acceptance: Every screen is usable at 360 px width without horizontal scroll; Playwright mobile-viewport journeys pass; installable PWA retained.

name: Job cards
acceptance: Jobs have a property, ordered timeline of events, notes and evidence files, each change audited and tenant-scoped.

name: Quotes
acceptance: Quotes have versions, states draft/approved/sent/accepted/rejected/expired/superseded, acceptance tokens and a server-rendered PDF; invalid transitions are refused; prices only from approved rates.

name: AI email and message management
acceptance: Inbound email/messages are normalised, de-duplicated and linked to customer/job; agent drafts replies; nothing is sent without owner approval.

name: NZ-compliant financial documents
acceptance: Invoices render as NZ tax invoices with supplier GST number and required fields (rules to be confirmed against IRD guidance).

name: Unpaid invoice follow-ups
acceptance: Overdue invoices produce draft follow-ups and reminders; each send needs owner approval; reminders fire once and survive restarts.

name: Customer and property CRM
acceptance: Customers have contacts and multiple properties; search covers properties; archive preserves history.

name: Data ownership and export
acceptance: Owner can export one customer or the whole tenant as JSON plus files; encrypted backup and restore verified, including restic drill in Phase 7.

name: GST in quotes
acceptance: Fractional quantities, markup and per-line tax treatment (standard/zero-rated/exempt) priced with integer arithmetic; rounding rule stated on the quote.

name: Scheduling
acceptance: Appointments with availability and DST-correct display in the business time zone; calendar in PWA; ICS export.

name: AI invoice preparation
acceptance: invoice.prepare tool proposes an invoice from job and quote data; backend builds lines; owner approves before issue.
